Stephanie — noted. Two quick things from SE side:

1) DST quirk: US switches to DST on Mar 8, 2026 while EU (Ireland) switches back on Mar 29, 2026 — during the weeks in between, offsets can look odd. So explicitly setting the timezone on the event (Europe/Dublin) is the safest.

2) Forwarded invites: when an event is forwarded or recreated in another calendar system, some clients interpret it as a floating event (no TZ), which then renders based on local timezone. If Liam accepts and it shows the wrong time, ask him to open the event in calendar.google.com -> Event details -> Event timezone.

If helpful I can attach a screenshot of what the timezone field looks like in the GC event — attaching now.

Thanks,
